ns2:course.label: International Business
ns2:course.description: Introduces the field of international business and management. Examines the economic, political, and legal environments of international business. Analyzes differences in financial management, marketing, and management practices for firms doing business abroad.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Finance or Industrial Engineering or International Business or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Systems Engineering and Design or Information Systems or Operations Management or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship or Strategy, Innovation & Entrep or Business + Data Science major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
